rows.label: Voynich manuscript
rows.description: illustrated codex hand-written in an unknown writing system
rows.hook: is a medieval book full of strange plants and stars, written in a script nobody has ever managed to read

rows.label: Amelia Earhart
rows.description: American aviation pioneer and author (1897–1939)
rows.hook: was a famed female pilot who vanished over the Pacific while trying to fly around the world

rows.label: Bermuda Triangle
rows.description: region in the western part of the North Atlantic Ocean between Florida, Bermuda and Puerto Rico
rows.hook: is a patch of ocean where ships and planes are said to disappear without a trace

rows.label: Area 51
rows.description: classified United States Air Force base at Groom Lake in Nye and Lincoln counties in Nevada, United States
rows.hook: is a secretive desert military site that conspiracy fans link to crashed flying saucers

rows.label: Stonehenge
rows.description: Neolithic henge monument in Amesbury, Wiltshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is a ring of giant standing stones on Salisbury Plain whose purpose is still debated

rows.label: Bigfoot
rows.description: large and hairy ape-like mythical creature purported to inhabit forests in North America
rows.hook: is a huge, hairy, ape-like creature said to roam the forests of the Pacific Northwest

rows.label: Loch Ness Monster
rows.description: lake monster of Scottish folklore
rows.hook: is a long-necked creature said to lurk in a deep Highland lake, famously photographed in a hoax

rows.label: Atlantis
rows.description: mythological large island in Plato's dialogues
rows.hook: is a legendary island civilization that supposedly sank beneath the sea in a single day

rows.label: Chupacabra
rows.description: legendary creature; first purported sighting in Puerto Rico
rows.hook: is a fanged creature blamed for draining the blood of goats and livestock

rows.label: Mothman
rows.description: a singular legendary creature based around West Virginia, United States
rows.hook: is a red-eyed winged humanoid said to have been seen before a deadly bridge collapse

rows.label: Tunguska event
rows.description: powerful explosion that occurred near the Podkamennaya Tunguska River
rows.hook: was a huge blast in the Siberian wilderness that flattened millions of trees, likely from a space rock

rows.label: Wow! signal
rows.description: 1977 narrowband radio signal from SETI
rows.hook: was a powerful burst of radio noise from deep space that an astronomer circled and marked with a comment

rows.label: Roswell incident
rows.description: 1947 unspecified object crash near Corona, New Mexico, US
rows.hook: is a desert crash that some say was an alien craft, though the military called it a weather balloon

rows.label: Yeti
rows.description: ape-like creature purported to inhabit the Himalayan mountain range in Asia
rows.hook: is the shaggy "abominable snowman" said to leave giant footprints in the high mountains

rows.label: Mary Celeste
rows.description: Ship found abandoned in the Atlantic Ocean in 1872
rows.hook: was a merchant ship found drifting at sea in perfect order with nobody aboard

rows.label: Nazca Lines
rows.description: large geoglyphs made in the soil of the Nazca Desert in Peru
rows.hook: are enormous drawings of animals and shapes etched into the desert floor, best seen from above

rows.label: Percy Fawcett
rows.description: British explorer, anthropologist and archaeologist (1867–1925)
rows.hook: was a colonel who disappeared while hunting for a fabled lost city in the Amazon jungle

rows.label: Jersey Devil
rows.description: also known as the Leeds Devil, legendary creature said to inhabit southern New Jersey, USA
rows.hook: is a winged, hoofed creature of pine-barren legend said to be the thirteenth child of a witch

rows.label: Kaspar Hauser
rows.description: man with a mysterious history (1812–1833)
rows.hook: was a teenager who turned up in a town square with almost no speech and no known past, later murdered

rows.label: crop circle
rows.description: pattern in a crop field
rows.hook: are intricate flattened patterns that appear overnight in fields and are often blamed on aliens
